items.title: Goldman Sachs Eyes $70B Revenue Base as Asset, Wealth Growth Accelerates
items.summary: David Solomon, chairman and chief executive officer of The Goldman Sachs Group (NYSE:GS), said the firm is focused on expanding earnings, improving operating efficiency and building a more durable revenue base as it pursues growth across Global Banking & Markets and Asset & Wealth Management

items.title: Goldman Sachs Projects Softer Quarter for Fixed Income
items.summary: Goldman Sachs Chief Executive David Solomon warned of a softer third quarter for the bank’s fixed-income trading business, while its equities and asset-management businesses remained strong.  Goldman’s fixed income, currencies and commodities business has been softer than its equities business, which “continues to be very strong,” Solomon said at a financial-services conference hosted by Barclays.  In asset and wealth management, Solomon said Goldman was exceeding its growth target of high-single digit percentages.

items.title: Goldman Sachs stock falls after CEO warns of softer trading
items.summary: Investing.com -- Goldman Sachs Group Inc. (NYSE:GS) shares fell 4% Wednesday after Chief Executive Officer David Solomon warned of softer fixed-income trading and higher expenses during the third quarter.

items.title: Goldman CEO Warns of Higher Costs, Softness in Fixed Income
items.summary: Goldman Sachs Group Inc. Chief Executive Officer David Solomon cautioned that the bank’s fixed-income trading business is softer than in past quarters and that expenses are running higher across the firm.

items.title: Goldman eyes strategic buyers with $11.7B PE haul
items.summary: Goldman Sachs Asset Management has sized its latest flagship buyout fund, in part, to remain within reach of strategic buyers, the firm’s global co-head of private equity told PitchBook. Speaking Tuesday after the close of West Street Capital Partners IX, which raised $9.6 billion of commitments, Michael Bruun said that targeting companies with enterprise values of $500 million to $3 billion ensures those businesses remain within reach of corporate acquirers even if they double or triple in size

items.title: Can PNC's Record Capital Markets Pace Support Its Fee-Income Outlook?
items.summary: PNC Financial's capital markets business is on pace for a record year, driving fee-income growth and supporting its 2026 outlook. Can the momentum continue?
